assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
occurring in the context of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate and rhythm control strategies
addressing the documented indications of syncope (R55)
